description: Black-box probing battery (B2 expansion). Each scenario is run against every routable local model; outputs are captured verbatim and used to build per-model fitness profiles. Categories cover model fundamentals (G), codex-specific patterns (C), a toy CLI app at various stages of construction (N), format-specific tests (F), and stress / size variations (S). Each scenario declares request_shape (chat or responses) and modes (which dispatch paths to exercise: non_stream, stream, or both).

shape_notes.chat: OpenAI chat-completions shape: messages=[{role,content}], max_tokens. Hits /v1/chat/completions on the gateway.
shape_notes.responses: OpenAI Responses-API shape: input=[{type:message,role,content:[{type:input_text,text}]}], max_output_tokens. Hits /v1/responses on per-model proxies and on callosum.

noteapp_context: Hypothetical personal note-taking CLI. Used to anchor codex-style prompts in something that feels like real dev work without needing captured user traffic. Scenarios reference parse_args, list/add/delete subcommands, JSON output, tests, debugging, etc.
